tagline.en: EventVLA — a Qwen3-VL-based vision-language-action policy with keyframe memory for longer-horizon manipulation.
tagline.zh: EventVLA——基于 Qwen3-VL 的视觉-语言-动作策略,带关键帧记忆,面向更长时程的操作任务。

en: EventVLA is a vision-language-action (VLA) model from InternRobotics. It encodes observations and instructions with a Qwen3-VL backbone and predicts the actions a robot should take, with a design aimed at tasks that unfold over a longer horizon.

Beyond a standard action head, EventVLA adds an event head, temporal anchors, and a compact keyframe-image memory that retains a small set of past frames. This lets the policy reason about what has already happened rather than only the current view. It builds on the Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct encoder and predicts a multi-step action chunk. You can also pass explicit temporal and memory-keyframe images to override the built-in history.
In WorldFoundry, EventVLA runs in-process from local assets — supply the current views (and optionally memory frames), and it returns an action chunk.
zh: EventVLA 是 InternRobotics 推出的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型。它用 Qwen3-VL 主干编码观测与指令,预测机器人应执行的动作,设计上面向那些需要在较长时程内展开的任务。
在标准动作头之外,EventVLA 还加入了 event head、时间锚点,以及一个紧凑的关键帧图像记忆,用于保留少量过去的画面。这让策略能够对已经发生的事情进行推理,而不只看当前视角。它构建在 Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct 编码器之上,预测多步动作序列。你也可以显式传入时间序列图像与记忆关键帧,覆盖内置的历史。
在 WorldFoundry 中,EventVLA 直接从本地资产在进程内运行——提供当前视角(以及可选的记忆帧),它就返回一段动作序列。

whenToUse.en: Choose EventVLA when your manipulation task benefits from short-term visual memory — where the right action depends on recent frames, not just the current observation.
whenToUse.zh: 当你的操作任务需要短期视觉记忆时(正确动作取决于最近若干帧,而不只是当前观测),EventVLA 是合适的选择。

notFor.en: It outputs robot actions rather than generated video or images, and closed-loop use requires a matching robot or simulator. Both the EventVLA checkpoint and the Qwen3-VL encoder are downloaded separately.
notFor.zh: 它输出的是机器人动作,而非生成的视频或图像,闭环使用需要匹配的机器人或仿真器。EventVLA checkpoint 与 Qwen3-VL 编码器均需单独下载。
